collection.title: Ford Mondeo Saloon 1996 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Mondeo Saloon 1996 - 2000 model requires a 21" wiper blade for the drivers and a 20" passengers side with a Standard Hook Arm attachment, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
